Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Talia Amarun: 37-year-old woman, 164 cm (medium), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: square compact face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: sculptural fringe. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette terracotta-black. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
